convention: Vacated = players listed Out or Doubtful (the engine's own convention in scripts/strategy_lab.py::rollup). At risk = players listed Questionable; they are NOT counted as absent. Both sums use only official season per-game figures the repository has captured (top 31 by minutes per game), so every total is a FLOOR.
unknown_policy: A player with no captured official minutes figure is counted in players_without_official_minutes and contributes 0, never an estimate. A team-side whose state is not FILED produces None, never 0.
replacement_not_quantified: Who absorbs the vacated minutes, and how much of the vacated production they replace, is NOT quantified; it needs per-player game logs and on/off splits, which no official source reached so far provides in text-extractable form.
field_note: The engine's field is spelled minutes_vacuum (sic); it is reproduced verbatim here and the spelling is logged as flag F-94E6D41B-05.
